description: Retrieve all sales invoices created in the last 30 days
sql_query: SELECT * FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-06', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-06', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N';

description: Get all invoice line items for a specific invoice number
sql_query: SELECT * FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE WHERE SALES_NO = 'INV-2026-0001' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'C001';

description: List all sales invoices for a specific customer
sql_query: SELECT SALES_NO, SALES_DATE, ITEM_CODE, QUANTITY, TOTAL_PRICE FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE WHERE CUSTOMER_CODE = 'CUST0001' AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY SALES_DATE DESC;

description: Find all invoices created by a specific employee/salesperson
sql_query: SELECT SALES_NO, SALES_DATE, CUSTOMER_CODE, TOTAL_PRICE FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE WHERE EMPLOYEE_CODE = 'EMP0025' AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N';

description: List all invoices for a specific branch and company
sql_query: SELECT SALES_NO, SALES_DATE, CUSTOMER_CODE, TOTAL_PRICE FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE WHERE BRANCH_CODE = 'BR01' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'C001' AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N';

description: Get all invoices between two given dates
sql_query: SELECT SALES_NO, SALES_DATE, CUSTOMER_CODE, TOTAL_PRICE FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-06-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N';

description: Retrieve invoices with a specific sales type code
sql_query: SELECT SALES_NO, SALES_DATE, CUSTOMER_CODE, TOTAL_PRICE FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE WHERE SALES_TYPE_CODE = 'CASH' AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N';

description: Find invoices with credit days greater than 30
sql_query: SELECT SALES_NO, CUSTOMER_CODE, CREDIT_DAYS, TOTAL_PRICE FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE WHERE CREDIT_DAYS > 30 AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N';

description: List invoices paid via a specific payment mode
sql_query: SELECT SALES_NO, SALES_DATE, CUSTOMER_CODE, PAYMENT_MODE, TOTAL_PRICE FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE WHERE PAYMENT_MODE = 'BANK_TRANSFER' AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N';

description: Retrieve invoices where free quantity was given
sql_query: SELECT SALES_NO, ITEM_CODE, QUANTITY, FREE_QTY FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE WHERE FREE_QTY > 0 AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N';

description: Get total sales value for the previous month
sql_query:
SELECT SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N';

description: Get total sales value for the current month
sql_query:
SELECT SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-09-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N';

description: Get total quantity sold last month
sql_query:
SELECT SUM(QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_QUANTITY
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N';

description: Get total number of invoices generated last month
sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT SALES_NO) AS INVOICE_COUNT
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N';

description: Get average invoice value for the last 90 days
sql_query:
SELECT AVG(TOTAL_PRICE) AS AVG_INVOICE_VALUE
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-05-07', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-06', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N';

description: Get total sales value grouped by branch for the previous month
sql_query:
SELECT BRANCH_CODE, SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY BRANCH_CODE
ORDER BY TOTAL_SALES DESC;

description: Get total sales value grouped by division for the previous month
sql_query:
SELECT DIVISION_CODE, SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY DIVISION_CODE
ORDER BY TOTAL_SALES DESC;

description: Get total sales value grouped by customer for the previous month
sql_query:
SELECT CUSTOMER_CODE, SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY CUSTOMER_CODE
ORDER BY TOTAL_SALES DESC;

description: Get total sales value grouped by item for the previous month
sql_query:
SELECT ITEM_CODE, SUM(QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_QTY, SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY ITEM_CODE
ORDER BY TOTAL_SALES DESC;

description: Get total sales value grouped by employee/salesperson for the previous month
sql_query:
SELECT EMPLOYEE_CODE, SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY EMPLOYEE_CODE
ORDER BY TOTAL_SALES DESC;

description: Get total sales value grouped by sales type (cash/credit) for the previous month
sql_query:
SELECT SALES_TYPE_CODE, SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY SALES_TYPE_CODE
ORDER BY TOTAL_SALES DESC;

description: Get daily sales totals for the previous month
sql_query:
SELECT TRUNC(SALES_DATE) AS SALES_DAY, SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY TRUNC(SALES_DATE)
ORDER BY SALES_DAY;

description: Get total sales value grouped by currency code
sql_query:
SELECT CURRENCY_CODE, SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
WHERE DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY CURRENCY_CODE;

description: Count number of invoices per branch for the previous month
sql_query:
SELECT BRANCH_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT SALES_NO) AS INVOICE_COUNT
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY BRANCH_CODE
ORDER BY INVOICE_COUNT DESC;

description: Get total luxury tax and excise duty collected last month
sql_query:
SELECT SUM(LUXURY_TAX_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_LUXURY_TAX, SUM(EXCISE_DUTY_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_EXCISE_DUTY
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N';

description: Compare total sales of current month vs previous month
sql_query:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-08-01','YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-09-01','YYYY-MM-DD') THEN TOTAL_PRICE ELSE 0 END) AS CURRENT_MONTH_SALES,
  SUM(CASE WHEN TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01','YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01','YYYY-MM-DD') THEN TOTAL_PRICE ELSE 0 END) AS PREVIOUS_MONTH_SALES
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
WHERE DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
  AND SALES_DATE >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01','YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND SALES_DATE < TO_DATE('2026-09-01','YYYY-MM-DD');

description: Get month-wise sales trend for the last 12 months
sql_query:
SELECT TO_CHAR(SALES_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') AS SALES_MONTH, SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2025-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-06', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(SALES_DATE, 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY SALES_MONTH;

description: Calculate month-over-month sales growth percentage
sql_query:
SELECT SALES_MONTH,
       TOTAL_SALES,
       ROUND((TOTAL_SALES - LAG(TOTAL_SALES) OVER (ORDER BY SALES_MONTH))
             / LAG(TOTAL_SALES) OVER (ORDER BY SALES_MONTH) * 100, 2) AS MOM_GROWTH_PCT
FROM (
  SELECT TO_CHAR(SALES_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') AS SALES_MONTH, SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
  FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
  WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2025-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-06', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
  GROUP BY TO_CHAR(SALES_DATE, 'YYYY-MM')
)
ORDER BY SALES_MONTH;

description: Get year-over-year sales comparison for the same month
sql_query:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01','YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01','YYYY-MM-DD') THEN TOTAL_PRICE ELSE 0 END) AS THIS_YEAR_SALES,
  SUM(CASE WHEN TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2025-07-01','YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2025-08-01','YYYY-MM-DD') THEN TOTAL_PRICE ELSE 0 END) AS LAST_YEAR_SALES
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
WHERE DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
  AND SALES_DATE >= TO_DATE('2025-07-01','YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND SALES_DATE < TO_DATE('2026-08-01','YYYY-MM-DD');

description: Get quarterly sales totals for the current fiscal year
sql_query:
SELECT TO_CHAR(SALES_DATE, 'YYYY') AS SALES_YEAR, TO_CHAR(SALES_DATE, 'Q') AS QUARTER, SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2027-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(SALES_DATE, 'YYYY'), TO_CHAR(SALES_DATE, 'Q')
ORDER BY SALES_YEAR, QUARTER;

description: Get weekly sales totals for the last 8 weeks
sql_query:
SELECT TRUNC(SALES_DATE, 'IW') AS WEEK_START, SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-06-10', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-06', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY TRUNC(SALES_DATE, 'IW')
ORDER BY WEEK_START;

description: Identify the best sales month in the last 12 months and give 1 row only
sql_query:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT TO_CHAR(SALES_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') AS SALES_MONTH, SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
  FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
  WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2025-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-06', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
  GROUP BY TO_CHAR(SALES_DATE, 'YYYY-MM')
  ORDER BY TOTAL_SALES DESC
) WHERE ROWNUM = 1;

description: Get running cumulative sales total for the current year
sql_query:
SELECT SALES_MONTH, TOTAL_SALES,
       SUM(TOTAL_SALES) OVER (ORDER BY SALES_MONTH) AS CUMULATIVE_SALES
FROM (
  SELECT TO_CHAR(SALES_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') AS SALES_MONTH, SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
  FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
  WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2027-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
  GROUP BY TO_CHAR(SALES_DATE, 'YYYY-MM')
)
ORDER BY SALES_MONTH;

description: Get average daily sales value for the previous month
sql_query:
SELECT SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) / COUNT(DISTINCT TRUNC(SALES_DATE)) AS AVG_DAILY_SALES
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N';

description: Compare sales of last month to the same month last year
sql_query:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01','YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01','YYYY-MM-DD') THEN TOTAL_PRICE ELSE 0 END) AS LAST_MONTH_SALES,
  SUM(CASE WHEN TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2025-07-01','YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2025-08-01','YYYY-MM-DD') THEN TOTAL_PRICE ELSE 0 END) AS SAME_MONTH_LAST_YEAR_SALES
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
WHERE DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
  AND ((SALES_DATE >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01','YYYY-MM-DD') AND SALES_DATE < TO_DATE('2026-08-01','YYYY-MM-DD'))
    OR (SALES_DATE >= TO_DATE('2025-07-01','YYYY-MM-DD') AND SALES_DATE < TO_DATE('2025-08-01','YYYY-MM-DD')));

description: Get top 10 customers by sales value in the previous month and give 10 row only
sql_query:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT CUSTOMER_CODE, SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
  FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
  WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
  GROUP BY CUSTOMER_CODE
  ORDER BY TOTAL_SALES DESC
) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10;

description: Get top 10 best-selling items by quantity in the previous month and give 10 row only
sql_query:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT ITEM_CODE, SUM(QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_QTY
  FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
  WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
  GROUP BY ITEM_CODE
  ORDER BY TOTAL_QTY DESC
) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10;

description: Get top 5 branches by sales revenue in the previous month and give 5 row only
sql_query:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT BRANCH_CODE, SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
  FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
  WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
  GROUP BY BRANCH_CODE
  ORDER BY TOTAL_SALES DESC
) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5;

description: Get top 5 salespersons by total sales value in the previous month and give 5 row only
sql_query:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT EMPLOYEE_CODE, SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
  FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
  WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
  GROUP BY EMPLOYEE_CODE
  ORDER BY TOTAL_SALES DESC
) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5;

description: Find the least performing branch by sales value in the previous month and give 1 row only
sql_query:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT BRANCH_CODE, SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
  FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
  WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
  GROUP BY BRANCH_CODE
  ORDER BY TOTAL_SALES ASC
) WHERE ROWNUM = 1;

description: Rank customers by total purchase value in the current year
sql_query:
SELECT CUSTOMER_CODE, TOTAL_SALES,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TOTAL_SALES DESC) AS SALES_RANK
FROM (
  SELECT CUSTOMER_CODE, SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
  FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
  WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2027-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
  GROUP BY CUSTOMER_CODE
);

description: Get top 10 items by total revenue for the current year and give 10 row only
sql_query:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT ITEM_CODE, SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
  FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
  WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2027-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
  GROUP BY ITEM_CODE
  ORDER BY TOTAL_SALES DESC
) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10;

description: Find customers who purchased only once in the last 6 months
sql_query:
SELECT CUSTOMER_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT SALES_NO) AS INVOICE_COUNT
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-02-05', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-06', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY CUSTOMER_CODE
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT SALES_NO) = 1;

description: Find customers with the highest average order value
sql_query:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT CUSTOMER_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_PRICE) AS AVG_ORDER_VALUE
  FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
  WHERE DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
  GROUP BY CUSTOMER_CODE
  ORDER BY AVG_ORDER_VALUE DESC
) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10;

description: Get top 3 sales types by revenue contribution in the previous month and give 3 row only
sql_query:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT SALES_TYPE_CODE, SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
  FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
  WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
  GROUP BY SALES_TYPE_CODE
  ORDER BY TOTAL_SALES DESC
) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3;

description: Get item-wise sales report with item description for the previous month
sql_query:
SELECT i.ITEM_CODE, im.ITEM_EDESC, SUM(i.QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_QTY, SUM(i.TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE i
JOIN IP_ITEM_MASTER_SETUP im
  ON i.ITEM_CODE = im.ITEM_CODE AND i.COMPANY_CODE = im.COMPANY_CODE
WHERE TRUNC(i.SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(i.SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND i.DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY i.ITEM_CODE, im.ITEM_EDESC
ORDER BY TOTAL_SALES DESC;

description: Get category-wise sales report for the previous month
sql_query:
SELECT c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_EDESC, SUM(i.TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE i
JOIN IP_ITEM_MASTER_SETUP im
  ON i.ITEM_CODE = im.ITEM_CODE AND i.COMPANY_CODE = im.COMPANY_CODE
JOIN IP_CATEGORY_CODE c
  ON im.CATEGORY_CODE = c.CATEGORY_CODE AND im.COMPANY_CODE = c.COMPANY_CODE
WHERE TRUNC(i.SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(i.SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND i.DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_EDESC
ORDER BY TOTAL_SALES DESC;

description: Get top 10 best-selling items with their category description and give 10 row only
sql_query:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT im.ITEM_CODE, im.ITEM_EDESC, c.CATEGORY_EDESC, SUM(i.TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
  FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE i
  JOIN IP_ITEM_MASTER_SETUP im ON i.ITEM_CODE = im.ITEM_CODE AND i.COMPANY_CODE = im.COMPANY_CODE
  JOIN IP_CATEGORY_CODE c ON im.CATEGORY_CODE = c.CATEGORY_CODE AND im.COMPANY_CODE = c.COMPANY_CODE
  WHERE i.DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
  GROUP BY im.ITEM_CODE, im.ITEM_EDESC, c.CATEGORY_EDESC
  ORDER BY TOTAL_SALES DESC
) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10;

description: Get sales report for a specific product category in the previous month
sql_query:
SELECT im.ITEM_CODE, im.ITEM_EDESC, SUM(i.QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_QTY, SUM(i.TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE i
JOIN IP_ITEM_MASTER_SETUP im ON i.ITEM_CODE = im.ITEM_CODE AND i.COMPANY_CODE = im.COMPANY_CODE
WHERE im.CATEGORY_CODE = 'BV'
  AND TRUNC(i.SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(i.SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND i.DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY im.ITEM_CODE, im.ITEM_EDESC
ORDER BY TOTAL_SALES DESC;

description: Get sales report grouped by brand name for the previous month
sql_query:
SELECT s.BRAND_NAME, SUM(i.TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE i
JOIN IP_ITEM_SPEC_SETUP s ON i.ITEM_CODE = s.ITEM_CODE AND i.COMPANY_CODE = s.COMPANY_CODE
WHERE TRUNC(i.SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(i.SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND i.DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY s.BRAND_NAME
ORDER BY TOTAL_SALES DESC;

description: Find items sold below their standard rate in the previous month
sql_query:
SELECT i.ITEM_CODE, im.ITEM_EDESC, i.UNIT_PRICE, im.STD_RATE
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE i
JOIN IP_ITEM_MASTER_SETUP im ON i.ITEM_CODE = im.ITEM_CODE AND i.COMPANY_CODE = im.COMPANY_CODE
WHERE i.UNIT_PRICE < im.STD_RATE
  AND TRUNC(i.SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(i.SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND i.DELETED_FLAG = 'N';

description: Get sales report with item shelf life for perishable/expiring items
sql_query:
SELECT i.ITEM_CODE, im.ITEM_EDESC, im.SHELF_LIFE_DAYS, SUM(i.QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_QTY
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE i
JOIN IP_ITEM_MASTER_SETUP im ON i.ITEM_CODE = im.ITEM_CODE AND i.COMPANY_CODE = im.COMPANY_CODE
WHERE im.SHELF_LIFE_DAYS IS NOT NULL
  AND i.DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY i.ITEM_CODE, im.ITEM_EDESC, im.SHELF_LIFE_DAYS
ORDER BY im.SHELF_LIFE_DAYS ASC;

description: Get total sales value and gross profit estimate using purchase price vs sales price
sql_query:
SELECT i.ITEM_CODE, im.ITEM_EDESC,
       SUM(i.QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_QTY,
       SUM(i.TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES,
       SUM(i.QUANTITY * im.PURCHASE_PRICE) AS ESTIMATED_COST,
       SUM(i.TOTAL_PRICE) - SUM(i.QUANTITY * im.PURCHASE_PRICE) AS ESTIMATED_GROSS_PROFIT
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE i
JOIN IP_ITEM_MASTER_SETUP im ON i.ITEM_CODE = im.ITEM_CODE AND i.COMPANY_CODE = im.COMPANY_CODE
WHERE TRUNC(i.SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(i.SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND i.DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY i.ITEM_CODE, im.ITEM_EDESC
ORDER BY ESTIMATED_GROSS_PROFIT DESC;

description: List all active (non-deleted) product categories used in sales
sql_query:
SELECT DISTINCT c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_EDESC
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE i
JOIN IP_ITEM_MASTER_SETUP im ON i.ITEM_CODE = im.ITEM_CODE AND i.COMPANY_CODE = im.COMPANY_CODE
JOIN IP_CATEGORY_CODE c ON im.CATEGORY_CODE = c.CATEGORY_CODE AND im.COMPANY_CODE = c.COMPANY_CODE
WHERE i.DELETED_FLAG = 'N' AND c.DELETED_FLAG = 'N';

description: Get sales report for items belonging to a specific brand and color
sql_query:
SELECT s.ITEM_CODE, s.BRAND_NAME, s.COLOR, SUM(i.QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_QTY, SUM(i.TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE i
JOIN IP_ITEM_SPEC_SETUP s ON i.ITEM_CODE = s.ITEM_CODE AND i.COMPANY_CODE = s.COMPANY_CODE
WHERE s.BRAND_NAME = 'BrandX' AND s.COLOR = 'Red'
  AND i.DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY s.ITEM_CODE, s.BRAND_NAME, s.COLOR;

description: Find items sold that are below their reorder level after last month's sales
sql_query:
SELECT im.ITEM_CODE, im.ITEM_EDESC, im.CURRENT_STOCK, im.REORDER_LEVEL
FROM IP_ITEM_MASTER_SETUP im
WHERE im.CURRENT_STOCK < im.REORDER_LEVEL
  AND im.DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE i
    WHERE i.ITEM_CODE = im.ITEM_CODE AND i.COMPANY_CODE = im.COMPANY_CODE
      AND TRUNC(i.SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
      AND TRUNC(i.SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
      AND i.DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
  );

description: Get category-wise contribution percentage to total sales for the previous month
sql_query:
SELECT c.CATEGORY_EDESC,
       SUM(i.TOTAL_PRICE) AS CATEGORY_SALES,
       ROUND(SUM(i.TOTAL_PRICE) * 100 / SUM(SUM(i.TOTAL_PRICE)) OVER (), 2) AS PCT_OF_TOTAL
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE i
JOIN IP_ITEM_MASTER_SETUP im ON i.ITEM_CODE = im.ITEM_CODE AND i.COMPANY_CODE = im.COMPANY_CODE
JOIN IP_CATEGORY_CODE c ON im.CATEGORY_CODE = c.CATEGORY_CODE AND im.COMPANY_CODE = c.COMPANY_CODE
WHERE TRUNC(i.SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(i.SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND i.DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY c.CATEGORY_EDESC;

description: Get list of items sold that have no assigned brand specification
sql_query:
SELECT DISTINCT i.ITEM_CODE
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE i
LEFT JOIN IP_ITEM_SPEC_SETUP s ON i.ITEM_CODE = s.ITEM_CODE AND i.COMPANY_CODE = s.COMPANY_CODE
WHERE s.ITEM_CODE IS NULL
  AND i.DELETED_FLAG = 'N';

description: Get sales report for a specific HS Code (used for export/customs reporting)
sql_query:
SELECT im.HS_CODE, im.ITEM_CODE, im.ITEM_EDESC, SUM(i.QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_QTY, SUM(i.TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE i
JOIN IP_ITEM_MASTER_SETUP im ON i.ITEM_CODE = im.ITEM_CODE AND i.COMPANY_CODE = im.COMPANY_CODE
WHERE im.HS_CODE = '1901.90'
  AND i.DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY im.HS_CODE, im.ITEM_CODE, im.ITEM_EDESC;

description: List items sold with their unit of measure and average selling rate
sql_query:
SELECT i.ITEM_CODE, im.ITEM_EDESC, i.MU_CODE, AVG(i.UNIT_PRICE) AS AVG_SELLING_RATE
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE i
JOIN IP_ITEM_MASTER_SETUP im ON i.ITEM_CODE = im.ITEM_CODE AND i.COMPANY_CODE = im.COMPANY_CODE
WHERE i.DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY i.ITEM_CODE, im.ITEM_EDESC, i.MU_CODE;

description: Get sales report for service items (non-physical goods)
sql_query:
SELECT i.ITEM_CODE, im.ITEM_EDESC, SUM(i.TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE i
JOIN IP_ITEM_MASTER_SETUP im ON i.ITEM_CODE = im.ITEM_CODE AND i.COMPANY_CODE = im.COMPANY_CODE
WHERE im.SERVICE_ITEM_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND i.DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY i.ITEM_CODE, im.ITEM_EDESC;

description: Get sales report of items grouped by their preferred supplier
sql_query:
SELECT im.PREFERRED_SUPPLIER_CODE, SUM(i.TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE i
JOIN IP_ITEM_MASTER_SETUP im ON i.ITEM_CODE = im.ITEM_CODE AND i.COMPANY_CODE = im.COMPANY_CODE
WHERE i.DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY im.PREFERRED_SUPPLIER_CODE
ORDER BY TOTAL_SALES DESC;

description: Find fast-moving items: items sold more than 1000 units in the previous month
sql_query:
SELECT i.ITEM_CODE, im.ITEM_EDESC, SUM(i.QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_QTY
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE i
JOIN IP_ITEM_MASTER_SETUP im ON i.ITEM_CODE = im.ITEM_CODE AND i.COMPANY_CODE = im.COMPANY_CODE
WHERE TRUNC(i.SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(i.SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND i.DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY i.ITEM_CODE, im.ITEM_EDESC
HAVING SUM(i.QUANTITY) > 1000
ORDER BY TOTAL_QTY DESC;

description: Find slow-moving items: items with no sales in the last 90 days
sql_query:
SELECT im.ITEM_CODE, im.ITEM_EDESC
FROM IP_ITEM_MASTER_SETUP im
WHERE im.DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE i
    WHERE i.ITEM_CODE = im.ITEM_CODE AND i.COMPANY_CODE = im.COMPANY_CODE
      AND TRUNC(i.SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-05-07', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
      AND TRUNC(i.SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-06', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
      AND i.DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
  );

description: Get all pending sales orders (not yet fully completed)
sql_query: SELECT ORDER_NO, ORDER_DATE, CUSTOMER_CODE, ITEM_CODE, QUANTITY, COMPLETED_QUANTITY FROM SA_SALES_ORDER WHERE COMPLETED_QUANTITY < QUANTITY AND CANCEL_FLAG != 'Y' AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N';

description: Get total value of sales orders booked in the previous month
sql_query:
SELECT SUM(CALC_TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_ORDER_VALUE
FROM SA_SALES_ORDER
WHERE TRUNC(ORDER_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(ORDER_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N';

description: Get all cancelled sales orders in the previous month
sql_query:
SELECT ORDER_NO, ORDER_DATE, CUSTOMER_CODE, CANCEL_DATE, CANCEL_BY, CANCEL_REMARKS
FROM SA_SALES_ORDER
WHERE CANCEL_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND TRUNC(CANCEL_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(CANCEL_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD');

description: Compare total order value vs total discount given in the previous month
sql_query:
SELECT SUM(CALC_TOTAL_PRICE) AS NET_ORDER_VALUE, SUM(TOTAL_DISCOUNT) AS TOTAL_DISCOUNT_GIVEN
FROM SA_SALES_ORDER
WHERE TRUNC(ORDER_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(ORDER_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N';

description: Get orders with delivery date overdue and not yet completed
sql_query: SELECT ORDER_NO, CUSTOMER_CODE, DELIVERY_DATE, QUANTITY, COMPLETED_QUANTITY FROM SA_SALES_ORDER WHERE DELIVERY_DATE < SYSDATE AND COMPLETED_QUANTITY < QUANTITY AND CANCEL_FLAG != 'Y' AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N';

description: Get order fulfillment rate (completed quantity vs ordered quantity) by customer
sql_query:
SELECT CUSTOMER_CODE,
       SUM(QUANTITY) AS ORDERED_QTY,
       SUM(COMPLETED_QUANTITY) AS FULFILLED_QTY,
       ROUND(SUM(COMPLETED_QUANTITY) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(QUANTITY), 0), 2) AS FULFILLMENT_PCT
FROM SA_SALES_ORDER
WHERE DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY CUSTOMER_CODE
ORDER BY FULFILLMENT_PCT ASC;

description: Get top 10 items with highest ordered quantity in the previous month and give 10 row only
sql_query:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT ITEM_CODE, SUM(QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_ORDERED_QTY
  FROM SA_SALES_ORDER
  WHERE TRUNC(ORDER_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND TRUNC(ORDER_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
  GROUP BY ITEM_CODE
  ORDER BY TOTAL_ORDERED_QTY DESC
) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10;

description: Get sales orders grouped by sales tax code showing tax collected
sql_query:
SELECT SALES_TAX_CODE, SUM(SALES_TAX_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_TAX_COLLECTED
FROM SA_SALES_ORDER
WHERE TRUNC(ORDER_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(ORDER_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY SALES_TAX_CODE;

description: Get order-to-invoice conversion: orders that have zero completed quantity
sql_query: SELECT ORDER_NO, ORDER_DATE, CUSTOMER_CODE, ITEM_CODE, QUANTITY FROM SA_SALES_ORDER WHERE COMPLETED_QUANTITY = 0 AND CANCEL_FLAG != 'Y' AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N';

description: Get total selling price vs cost price margin for orders in the previous month
sql_query:
SELECT ITEM_CODE,
       SUM(QUANTITY * SELLING_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SELLING_VALUE,
       SUM(QUANTITY * COST_PRICE) AS TOTAL_COST_VALUE,
       SUM(QUANTITY * (SELLING_PRICE - COST_PRICE)) AS TOTAL_MARGIN
FROM SA_SALES_ORDER
WHERE TRUNC(ORDER_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(ORDER_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY ITEM_CODE
ORDER BY TOTAL_MARGIN DESC;

description: Get all sales chalans (delivery notes) issued in the previous month
sql_query: SELECT CHALAN_NO, CHALAN_DATE, CUSTOMER_CODE, ITEM_CODE, QUANTITY, TOTAL_PRICE FROM SA_SALES_CHALAN WHERE TRUNC(CHALAN_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRUNC(CHALAN_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N';

description: Get total dispatched quantity per branch in the previous month
sql_query:
SELECT BRANCH_CODE, SUM(QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_DISPATCHED_QTY
FROM SA_SALES_CHALAN
WHERE TRUNC(CHALAN_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(CHALAN_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY BRANCH_CODE
ORDER BY TOTAL_DISPATCHED_QTY DESC;

description: Get total VAT and discount amount collected via delivery chalans last month
sql_query:
SELECT SUM(VAT_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_VAT, SUM(DISCOUNT_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_DISCOUNT
FROM SA_SALES_CHALAN
WHERE TRUNC(CHALAN_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(CHALAN_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N';

description: Get chalans dispatched to a specific shipping address
sql_query: SELECT CHALAN_NO, CHALAN_DATE, CUSTOMER_CODE, SHIPPING_ADDRESS, TOTAL_PRICE FROM SA_SALES_CHALAN WHERE SHIPPING_ADDRESS LIKE '%Kathmandu%' AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N';

description: Get chalan-wise sales report grouped by agent code
sql_query:
SELECT AGENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT CHALAN_NO) AS CHALAN_COUNT, SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
FROM SA_SALES_CHALAN
WHERE TRUNC(CHALAN_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(CHALAN_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY AGENT_CODE
ORDER BY TOTAL_SALES DESC;

description: Find chalans where completed quantity is less than dispatched quantity
sql_query: SELECT CHALAN_NO, ITEM_CODE, QUANTITY, COMPLETED_QUANTITY FROM SA_SALES_CHALAN WHERE COMPLETED_QUANTITY < QUANTITY AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N';

description: Get total excise duty and luxury tax collected through chalans by branch
sql_query:
SELECT BRANCH_CODE, SUM(EXCISE_DUTY_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_EXCISE, SUM(LUXURY_TAX_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_LUXURY_TAX
FROM SA_SALES_CHALAN
WHERE TRUNC(CHALAN_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(CHALAN_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY BRANCH_CODE;

description: Get chalan transactions with free quantity given per item
sql_query: SELECT ITEM_CODE, SUM(QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_QTY, SUM(FREE_QTY) AS TOTAL_FREE_QTY FROM SA_SALES_CHALAN WHERE DELETED_FLAG = 'N' GROUP BY ITEM_CODE HAVING SUM(FREE_QTY) > 0;

description: Get total sales value dispatched via chalan for a specific sector
sql_query: SELECT SECTOR_NAME, SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES FROM SA_SALES_CHALAN WHERE SECTOR_CODE = 'SEC01' AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N' GROUP BY SECTOR_NAME;

description: Get chalan count and total value per payment mode for the previous month
sql_query:
SELECT PAYMENT_MODE, COUNT(DISTINCT CHALAN_NO) AS CHALAN_COUNT, SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
FROM SA_SALES_CHALAN
WHERE TRUNC(CHALAN_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(CHALAN_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY PAYMENT_MODE
ORDER BY TOTAL_SALES DESC;

description: Get total sales returns value for the previous month
sql_query:
SELECT SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_RETURN_VALUE
FROM SA_SALES_RETURN
WHERE TRUNC(RETURN_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(RETURN_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N';

description: Get sales returns grouped by reason for the previous month
sql_query:
SELECT REASON, COUNT(*) AS RETURN_COUNT, SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_RETURN_VALUE
FROM SA_SALES_RETURN
WHERE TRUNC(RETURN_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(RETURN_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY REASON
ORDER BY TOTAL_RETURN_VALUE DESC;

description: Get top 10 customers with the highest return value in the previous month and and give 10 row only
sql_query:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT CUSTOMER_CODE, SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_RETURN_VALUE
  FROM SA_SALES_RETURN
  WHERE TRUNC(RETURN_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND TRUNC(RETURN_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
  GROUP BY CUSTOMER_CODE
  ORDER BY TOTAL_RETURN_VALUE DESC
) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10;

description: Get top 10 items with the highest return quantity in the previous month and give 10 row only
sql_query:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT ITEM_CODE, SUM(QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_RETURN_QTY
  FROM SA_SALES_RETURN
  WHERE TRUNC(RETURN_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND TRUNC(RETURN_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
  GROUP BY ITEM_CODE
  ORDER BY TOTAL_RETURN_QTY DESC
) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10;

description: Calculate net sales (gross sales minus returns) for the previous month
sql_query:
SELECT
  (SELECT NVL(SUM(TOTAL_PRICE), 0) FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
   WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N')
  -
  (SELECT NVL(SUM(TOTAL_PRICE), 0) FROM SA_SALES_RETURN
   WHERE TRUNC(RETURN_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRUNC(RETURN_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N')
  AS NET_SALES
FROM DUAL;

description: Get return rate percentage (returns value / gross sales value) for the previous month
sql_query:
SELECT
  ROUND(
    (SELECT NVL(SUM(TOTAL_PRICE), 0) FROM SA_SALES_RETURN
     WHERE TRUNC(RETURN_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRUNC(RETURN_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N')
    /
    NULLIF((SELECT SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
     WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'), 0) * 100
  , 2) AS RETURN_RATE_PCT
FROM DUAL;

description: Get sales returns grouped by branch and division for the previous month
sql_query:
SELECT BRANCH_CODE, DIVISION_CODE, SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_RETURN_VALUE
FROM SA_SALES_RETURN
WHERE TRUNC(RETURN_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(RETURN_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY BRANCH_CODE, DIVISION_CODE
ORDER BY TOTAL_RETURN_VALUE DESC;

description: Get sales returns caused by defective items in the previous month
sql_query: SELECT RETURN_NO, RETURN_DATE, CUSTOMER_CODE, ITEM_CODE, QUANTITY, REASON FROM SA_SALES_RETURN WHERE REASON LIKE '%defect%' AND TRUNC(RETURN_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRUNC(RETURN_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N';

description: Get total VAT and excise amount reversed due to sales returns last month
sql_query:
SELECT SUM(VAT_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_VAT_REVERSED, SUM(EXCISE_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_EXCISE_REVERSED
FROM SA_SALES_RETURN
WHERE TRUNC(RETURN_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(RETURN_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N';

description: Get sales returns grouped by employee/salesperson to identify accounts with high return rates
sql_query:
SELECT EMPLOYEE_CODE, COUNT(*) AS RETURN_COUNT, SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_RETURN_VALUE
FROM SA_SALES_RETURN
WHERE TRUNC(RETURN_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(RETURN_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY EMPLOYEE_CODE
ORDER BY TOTAL_RETURN_VALUE DESC;

description: Generate a full previous-month sales summary: gross sales, returns, and net sales by branch
sql_query:
SELECT
  inv.BRANCH_CODE,
  NVL(inv.GROSS_SALES, 0) AS GROSS_SALES,
  NVL(ret.RETURN_VALUE, 0) AS RETURN_VALUE,
  NVL(inv.GROSS_SALES, 0) - NVL(ret.RETURN_VALUE, 0) AS NET_SALES
FROM
  (SELECT BRANCH_CODE, SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS GROSS_SALES
   FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
   WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
   GROUP BY BRANCH_CODE) inv
LEFT JOIN
  (SELECT BRANCH_CODE, SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS RETURN_VALUE
   FROM SA_SALES_RETURN
   WHERE TRUNC(RETURN_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRUNC(RETURN_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
   GROUP BY BRANCH_CODE) ret
ON inv.BRANCH_CODE = ret.BRANCH_CODE
ORDER BY NET_SALES DESC;

description: Compare order booked value vs actual invoiced value for the previous month, by customer
sql_query:
SELECT
  o.CUSTOMER_CODE,
  NVL(o.ORDERED_VALUE, 0) AS ORDERED_VALUE,
  NVL(i.INVOICED_VALUE, 0) AS INVOICED_VALUE,
  ROUND(NVL(i.INVOICED_VALUE, 0) * 100 / NULLIF(o.ORDERED_VALUE, 0), 2) AS CONVERSION_PCT
FROM
  (SELECT CUSTOMER_CODE, SUM(CALC_TOTAL_PRICE) AS ORDERED_VALUE
   FROM SA_SALES_ORDER
   WHERE TRUNC(ORDER_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRUNC(ORDER_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
   GROUP BY CUSTOMER_CODE) o
LEFT JOIN
  (SELECT CUSTOMER_CODE, SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS INVOICED_VALUE
   FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
   WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
   GROUP BY CUSTOMER_CODE) i
ON o.CUSTOMER_CODE = i.CUSTOMER_CODE
ORDER BY CONVERSION_PCT ASC;

description: Get item-wise dispatch-vs-invoice reconciliation for the previous month
sql_query:
SELECT
  im.ITEM_CODE, im.ITEM_EDESC,
  NVL(c.DISPATCHED_QTY, 0) AS DISPATCHED_QTY,
  NVL(inv.INVOICED_QTY, 0) AS INVOICED_QTY,
  NVL(c.DISPATCHED_QTY, 0) - NVL(inv.INVOICED_QTY, 0) AS QTY_VARIANCE
FROM IP_ITEM_MASTER_SETUP im
LEFT JOIN
  (SELECT ITEM_CODE, SUM(QUANTITY) AS DISPATCHED_QTY FROM SA_SALES_CHALAN
   WHERE TRUNC(CHALAN_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRUNC(CHALAN_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
   GROUP BY ITEM_CODE) c ON im.ITEM_CODE = c.ITEM_CODE
LEFT JOIN
  (SELECT ITEM_CODE, SUM(QUANTITY) AS INVOICED_QTY FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
   WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
   GROUP BY ITEM_CODE) inv ON im.ITEM_CODE = inv.ITEM_CODE
WHERE im.DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
  AND (NVL(c.DISPATCHED_QTY, 0) != 0 OR NVL(inv.INVOICED_QTY, 0) != 0);

description: Build a full monthly sales performance report by category: orders, invoiced sales, and returns
sql_query:
SELECT
  c.CATEGORY_EDESC,
  NVL(o.ORDER_VALUE, 0) AS ORDER_VALUE,
  NVL(i.SALES_VALUE, 0) AS SALES_VALUE,
  NVL(r.RETURN_VALUE, 0) AS RETURN_VALUE,
  NVL(i.SALES_VALUE, 0) - NVL(r.RETURN_VALUE, 0) AS NET_SALES_VALUE
FROM IP_CATEGORY_CODE c
LEFT JOIN
  (SELECT im.CATEGORY_CODE, SUM(o.CALC_TOTAL_PRICE) AS ORDER_VALUE
   FROM SA_SALES_ORDER o
   JOIN IP_ITEM_MASTER_SETUP im ON o.ITEM_CODE = im.ITEM_CODE AND o.COMPANY_CODE = im.COMPANY_CODE
   WHERE TRUNC(o.ORDER_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRUNC(o.ORDER_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND o.DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
   GROUP BY im.CATEGORY_CODE) o ON c.CATEGORY_CODE = o.CATEGORY_CODE
LEFT JOIN
  (SELECT im.CATEGORY_CODE, SUM(i.TOTAL_PRICE) AS SALES_VALUE
   FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE i
   JOIN IP_ITEM_MASTER_SETUP im ON i.ITEM_CODE = im.ITEM_CODE AND i.COMPANY_CODE = im.COMPANY_CODE
   WHERE TRUNC(i.SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRUNC(i.SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND i.DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
   GROUP BY im.CATEGORY_CODE) i ON c.CATEGORY_CODE = i.CATEGORY_CODE
LEFT JOIN
  (SELECT im.CATEGORY_CODE, SUM(r.TOTAL_PRICE) AS RETURN_VALUE
   FROM SA_SALES_RETURN r
   JOIN IP_ITEM_MASTER_SETUP im ON r.ITEM_CODE = im.ITEM_CODE AND r.COMPANY_CODE = im.COMPANY_CODE
   WHERE TRUNC(r.RETURN_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRUNC(r.RETURN_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND r.DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
   GROUP BY im.CATEGORY_CODE) r ON c.CATEGORY_CODE = r.CATEGORY_CODE
WHERE c.DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
ORDER BY NET_SALES_VALUE DESC;

description: Get a consolidated previous-month sales dashboard: total invoices, total quantity, total sales, total returns, and net sales
sql_query:
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT SALES_NO) FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
   WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N') AS TOTAL_INVOICES,
  (SELECT SUM(QUANTITY) FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
   WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N') AS TOTAL_QUANTITY,
  (SELECT SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
   WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N') AS TOTAL_SALES,
  (SELECT SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) FROM SA_SALES_RETURN
   WHERE TRUNC(RETURN_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRUNC(RETURN_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N') AS TOTAL_RETURNS,
  (SELECT SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
   WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N')
  -
  (SELECT NVL(SUM(TOTAL_PRICE), 0) FROM SA_SALES_RETURN
   WHERE TRUNC(RETURN_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRUNC(RETURN_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N') AS NET_SALES
FROM DUAL;

description: Get total sales value and number of distinct customers served per division for the previous month
sql_query:
SELECT DIVISION_CODE,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CUSTOMER_CODE) AS DISTINCT_CUSTOMERS,
       SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES
FROM SA_SALES_INVOICE
WHERE TRUNC(SALES_DATE) >= TO_DATE('2026-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND TRUNC(SALES_DATE) < TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
GROUP BY DIVISION_CODE
ORDER BY TOTAL_SALES DESC;
